meaning:
1) to fly fast, fly swiftly, dart through the air
1a) (Qal) to fly swiftly, dart

elsewhere.note: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
